Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; BHP/RIO/FMG exposure under pressure
Bathla construction collapse flags broader stress in Australia's construction and property-linked economy

Ratings agencies flagged Victoria's soaring state debt as a credit risk

risk_assessment.mitigation: Position in EV supply chain and charging infrastructure; reduce exposure to legacy fuel retailers

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window as rate fears persist, housing data deteriorates, and iron ore softness feeds through to mining earnings. Small-cap gold and critical-minerals names may outperform. RBA on hold but hawkish global backdrop limits upside.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if housing stabilises and EV transition drives new demand vectors. 'Bull case returns' narrative gains traction but is contingent on credit-loss provisioning stabilising and iron ore finding a floor. Australia's per-capita growth lag vs Canada remains a structural concern.
